title: Slope Spooky
desc: Slope Spooky trades neon for an eerie Halloween track while keeping the familiar downhill challenge. Steer the rolling ball past obstacles, hold your line and survive longer than your last spooky run.
howto: Steer away from blocks and gaps.
Keep the ball on the platform.
Increase your focus as speed rises.
tips: Look past the theme and read the track.
Keep a rhythm through straight sections.
